name: Visual Disruptor
description: According to scientific studies (not really, but it makes the claim sound more credible), the color combination in this animated paint, together with the movement of its hues, causes discomfort and a hint of nausea to whoever tries to focus on it from a certain distance... because aliens.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on June 2nd, 2019.
The paint could be received as a reward for reaching the paid Tier 51 of the June 2019 Challenge.
Visual Disruptor was added to the possible rewards pool of containers with the release of the July 2019 Challenge.
